To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the genetic variation in the MMP9 gene is associated with the risk of developing ESRD in patients with CKD.

1) the MMP9 rs3918242 polymorphism is associated with increased risk of ESRD in the Chinese population; 2) MMP9 rs3918237 polymorphism was associated with increased risk and MMP9 rs17576 was associated with decreased risk of ESRDs; 3) MMP9 rs17577 and rs3918242 were associated with the progression of ESRDs.
MMP9 rs3918242 and rs3918245 polymorphisms may be involved in the development of ESRD in the studied population, but the association was not confirmed in the replication cohort.

the role of MMP9 in the progression of chronic kidney disease.
